mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.status AS status, a.identifier AS username, a.credential AS password FROM sys_user u JOIN user_auth a ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.identifier = #{username} AND a.auth_type = 'password' AND u.status = 1 AND u.del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.is_hide = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.sort_order

SELECT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.perms, p.name AS parentName FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_menu p ON m.parent_id = p.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type = 'F' AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''
SELECT user_id, nickname, avatar, status FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status!=2
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_key FROM sys_role r LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1
SELECT identifier FROM user_auth WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND auth_type = 'password' LIMIT 1
